rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: PiQrypt creates tamper-evident, cryptographically signed audit trails for AI agent actions, using Ed25519 or post-quantum Dilithium3 signatures to authenticate each event. Actions are hash-chained so any modification invalidates subsequent records, enabling offline-verifiable compliance proofs for trading, HR, healthcare, and DevOps workflows. Integrates with Claude Desktop, n8n, and other MCP clients.
